short.loss_interpretation: Four measured losses comprise one clear semantic regression (意外→以外) and three finite-reference hiragana/kanji differences. The one both-wrong changed prediction is already semantically incorrect before the change; no hidden correct-to-wrong semantic loss found among these changed short predictions.
short.guard_interpretation: All200 guarded short full top5 lists exactly equal paired explicit no-right legacy results. This prevents the意外 regression and spelling misses, but gives up real right-dependent fixes. It additionally loses correctキッチンの電気つけ to no-right電気付, while the right baseline was already correct; hence fallback is a candidate-pool policy change, not a free safety improvement.

residual_candidate_gap.source: ゴリラは、そうそう木には登らない。
residual_candidate_gap.finding: Gold absent from all8 right-pool generated/validated candidates; ranking cannot recover it.

development_comparison.caution: Heldout deliberately changes author mix to100Gardenia/100others. Its baseline full accuracy is99/100Gardenia vs92/100others. Perfect100-case dev accuracy does not imply universal accuracy, and source/topic clustering does not remove shared author/style dependence.

limitations: Fixed two-character suffixes can cut a word mid-form; results apply to this explicit truncation test.
Finite spelling references hide some equivalent renderings; no posthoc lenient headline accuracy was recomputed.
Only200 independent source groups; three context variants are paired, not600 independent sentences.

post_unseal_review.implication: A threshold on the same suffix likelihood is not independent evidence of semantic correctness. Future candidate-pair calibration needs separate training evidence and a newly sealed evaluation, not weight tuning on these revealed200 sources.

python_tests.scope: All Japanese Python tests after final scorer implementation; no implementation changes since.

independent_audit.scope: Read-only independent audit after completed frozen report. No source/model/label edits, GPU inference, or parameter reselection.

numerical_drift.q_policy: First seen candidate score retained across fresh source variants; raw values and origins recorded; no numeric cap on q batch variation.
numerical_drift.none_z_policy: First none z retained only within declared tolerance; candidate lists must reproduce exactly.

sensitivity.method: Restore each fresh row original computed q in all pools and computed none z; for no-right restore all three z copies. Compare first candidates for fixed baseline and already-selected config only; no tuning.
sensitivity.limitation: Only first-candidate sensitivity; subleading ordering and raw score values may differ.

validation.first_attempt: Initial dev attempt stopped after536/826 rows when tiny no-right z floating-point drift violated exact equality. No selection or new heldout predictions existed. Preserved that attempt, diagnosed repeated generation as identical, then pinned only z drift <=1e-3 to first observation and restarted from the immutable historical526 rows.
validation.drift_sensitivity: Restoring every fresh row raw q and no-right z changes neither baseline nor selected top1 in any of900 fresh predictions. Full ranking invariance uses the recorded shared reference scores.
